name: Sweet and Sour Beef Lettuce Wraps with Bell Pepper, Carrot, Spicy Mayo & Peanuts (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Place beef, bread crumbs, egg, and spices in a medium bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the beef mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb lean ground beef
¼ cup panko bread crumbs
1 egg
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)
½ head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise.
Preheat another skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add additional oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the bell peppers are cooking, peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with water, soy sauce, cornstarch, vinegar, and sugar, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tsp cornstarch
1 tsp rice vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are done, remove 10 pieces to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. Add sauce to the skillet with the remaining meatballs. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened and meatballs are coated, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Place on another plate.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the plate with the grated carrot, keeping them separate.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the plate and set aside.
Place mayo, hot sauce, and salt in a clean small bowl, then whisk to combine the spicy mayo.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp hot sauce
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide plain meatballs, a ½-cup of grated carrot, a ½-cup of sautéed bell peppers, and wonton strips between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with saucy meatballs, remaining carrot, bell peppers, and green onions. Drizzle with spicy mayo, sprinkle with peanuts, and enjoy!
